Lee Equity acquired majority ownership in 2022 and its August 2026 company update supports continuing governance involvement. Bradford is deliberately classified as SUD-primary adjacent rather than adult primary-mental-health core. Its inpatient, residential, detox, outpatient, and extended-care footprint remains useful market context, but no beds or value enter the core target model without regulator-confirmed adult primary-mental-health residential capacity.

assertions.notes: Northpoint Recovery and Imagine by Northpoint resolve beneath Northpoint Recovery Holdings, LLC. The current company site reports 17 adult and adolescent centers across Idaho, Washington, Colorado, and Nebraska. Its residential/inpatient adult programs are presently described as addiction treatment with dual-diagnosis support; the primary adult mental-health Promise track and adolescent Imagine programs are outpatient. Northpoint is therefore a mature SUD-primary adjacent company, not a verified adult primary-mental-health residential target. The 2023 company disclosure names Atigun and Empeiria as sponsors and Atigun's current team page confirms continuing Northpoint chairmanship, but the complete current ownership table remains open.
